newsitem.title: LEBANON: Brazil wants to assist Lebanon in reconstruction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil wants to assist Lebanon in reconstruction.

text.p: Brazilian Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe Lampreia said on Monday that his country wanted to assist Lebanon in its reconstruction programme by signing bilateral economic, financial and investment deals.

"My country is ready to negotiate with Lebanon draft agreements over investment guarantees and dual taxation...We also hope to get our construction companies to Lebanon to assist in its reconstruction," Lampreia told reporters in Beirut.

Lampreia, who arrived to Beirut on a three-day visit, formally signed with his Lebanese counterpart Faris Bouez an aviation agreement under which Lebanon's Middle East Airlines had begun flying to Sao Paulo in 1995. The deal also gives Brazilian airlines the right to operate flights to Beirut.
The two ministers also signed an agreement to exchange cultural and educational expertise. Millions of Brazilians are descended from Lebanese immigrants.
"I told Minister Bouez about...our commitment to the reconstruction of Lebanon, this amazing drive in which we would like to take part even in the form of a limited role," Lampreia added.

He said Brazil supported Lebanon's demand for the implementation of U.N. security council resolution 425 calling for an immediate and unconditional withdrawal of Israeli troops from south Lebanon, adding that his country supported a "just and permanent" peace settlement in the Middle East.
